sources.title: Social network architecture of human immune cells unveiled by quantitative proteomics
sources.version: version of record 2017; database release unavailable
sources.notes: Publisher page is partial article access ; atlas main molecular matrix was not extracted. The study covers 28 human populations and total/secreted proteomes. Supplementary Fig. 3 explicitly reports that CD45RA/RO isoforms were not resolved by this MS workflow.

sources.version: Science 2011 version of record; PMC author manuscript available 2012-02-07
sources.notes: PMC author manuscript. PTM-site and reagent-clone details require supplement retrieval; no phosphorylation result is interpreted as downstream function.

sources.title: Simultaneous epitope and transcriptome measurement in single cells
sources.version: version of record 2017; database release unavailable

sources.title: Multiplexed quantification of proteins and transcripts in single cells
sources.version: version of record 2017; database release unavailable
sources.notes: Publisher PDF hosted by UCSF; article and methods inspected using web PDF text. Source extraction also saved in extract1.json, extract2.json and methods.json. Marker-RNA correlations do not measure receptor responsiveness.

sources.title: Plasma proteomic associations with genetics and health in the UK Biobank
sources.version: version of record 2023; database release unavailable
sources.notes: UKB-PPP Olink Explore 3072. The pQTL supports circulating assay signal association, not cell of origin or receptor activity. 2,941 analytes map to 2,923 unique proteins; replicated cytokine channels remain separate assay records.

sources.title: Large-scale plasma proteomics comparisons through genetics and disease associations
sources.version: version of record 2023; database release unavailable
sources.notes: Also see extract1.json and methods.json. UKB samples overlap UKB-PPP (P_S05); deCODE 2021 participants are reused. The authors regard 23% of Olink and 24% of SomaScan sentinel cis signals as potentially epitope-driven, based on PAV linkage without cis-eQTL linkage; this is an inference, not orthogonal validation of every target.

sources.title: Comparative studies of 2168 plasma proteins measured by two affinity-based platforms in 4000 Chinese adults
sources.version: version of record 2025; database release unavailable
sources.notes: Also see open4.json. Direct paired-sample CKB comparison used Olink Explore 3072 and SomaScan v4.1; median correlation was 0.29 across 2,749 reagent pairs and 0.26 for 1,694 one-to-one pairs. Same participants across assays are not independent replication.

sources.title: Activated platelets mediate inflammatory signaling by regulated interleukin 1β synthesis
sources.version: version of record 2001; database release unavailable
sources.notes: Human platelet secretion and endothelial adhesion experiments. Precursor and mature IL1B ELISAs were reported not to cross-react. Fig. 4 legend uses 18 h secretion collection whereas microvesicle methods describe 8 h; preserve this internal timing discrepancy.

assertions.subject: IL34
assertions.evidence_summary: IL34 altered the measured proteome of preactivated memory CD4 T cells.
assertions.uncertainty: Caption reports FDR <5%; effect sizes and signed protein-level changes unavailable. Total-profile differences do not establish both increase and decrease.
assertions.limitations: Aggregate profile assertion only; no individual protein, receptor dependence or function is established here. Main data matrix not reviewed.

assertions.subject: IL7
assertions.source_locator: Fig. 3C; main text ex vivo bone marrow analysis
assertions.evidence_summary: IL7 increased STAT5 phosphorylation in marrow T cells.
assertions.uncertainty: No effect estimate or interval extracted.
assertions.limitations: PTM site, antibody clone, dose and duration unavailable in extracted main text. Two donors; phosphorylation is not measured cell function.

assertions.subject: IL3
assertions.evidence_summary: IL3 did not induce STAT3 phosphorylation in mature B cells despite abundant IL3RA.
assertions.uncertainty: No effect estimate or interval extracted.
assertions.limitations: PTM site, antibody clone, dose and duration unavailable in extracted main text. Two donors; phosphorylation is not measured cell function.

assertions.subject: IFN-alpha (subtype unavailable)
assertions.evidence_summary: The IL3RA-positive B-cell population did induce STAT3 phosphorylation after IFN-alpha.
assertions.uncertainty: No effect estimate or interval extracted.
assertions.limitations: PTM site, antibody clone, dose and duration unavailable in extracted main text. Two donors; phosphorylation is not measured cell function.

assertions.subject: lipopolysaccharide
assertions.evidence_summary: LPS induced p38 phosphorylation in monocyte compartments.
assertions.uncertainty: No effect estimate or interval extracted.
assertions.limitations: PTM site, antibody clone, dose and duration unavailable in extracted main text. Two donors; phosphorylation is not measured cell function.

assertions.subject: dasatinib
assertions.source_locator: Fig. 5C as cited in the main-text STAT5 paragraph; bendall_fulltext.txt:181. Saved Fig. 5 legend at line 175 instead labels this STAT5 result B.
assertions.evidence_summary: Dasatinib left the IL7-induced T-cell STAT5 response of similar magnitude.
assertions.uncertainty: Qualitative similarity, not a formal equivalence test.
assertions.limitations: PTM site, antibody clone, dose and duration unavailable in extracted main text. Two donors; phosphorylation is not measured cell function. The saved source has a panel-label discrepancy: main text cites Fig. 5C for STAT5, while the Fig. 5 legend labels STAT5 B and PLC-gamma-2 C; use the specific STAT5 passage.

assertions.subject: NK-cell CD56-bright versus CD56-dim state
assertions.source_locator: Supplementary Fig. 6b caption; cite_publisher_page.txt:257 (also captured in open3.json)
assertions.evidence_summary: CD56-defined NK subsets differed in their CD8A antibody-tag distributions.
assertions.uncertainty: Two-sample KS P<0.001; effect magnitude unavailable.
assertions.limitations: Subset definitions derive from CD56 protein. Donor-level uncertainty and direction not extracted; no cytotoxicity inferred.

assertions.subject: NK-cell CD56-bright versus CD56-dim state
assertions.evidence_summary: CD4 antibody-tag controls showed no reported difference between CD56-defined NK subsets.
assertions.uncertainty: No equivalence bound; low or absent signal.
assertions.limitations: A low-abundance assay null does not prove protein absence.

assertions.subject: CD27 agonist antibody
assertions.evidence_summary: Adding CD27 costimulation reduced IL7R protein.
assertions.uncertainty: Magnitude unavailable; RNA non-detection can reflect sensitivity.
assertions.limitations: Three donors; endpoint depends on co-stimulation and viable-cell selection. No receptor-response or functional outcome inferred.

assertions.subject: CD27 agonist antibody
assertions.evidence_summary: Adding CD27 costimulation also reduced IL7R RNA.
assertions.uncertainty: Magnitude unavailable; RNA non-detection can reflect sensitivity.
assertions.limitations: Three donors; endpoint depends on co-stimulation and viable-cell selection. No receptor-response or functional outcome inferred.

assertions.subject: CD27 agonist antibody
assertions.evidence_summary: CD27 costimulation increased ICOS protein.
assertions.uncertainty: Magnitude unavailable; RNA non-detection can reflect sensitivity.
assertions.limitations: Three donors; endpoint depends on co-stimulation and viable-cell selection. No receptor-response or functional outcome inferred.

assertions.subject: CD27 agonist antibody
assertions.evidence_summary: A corresponding ICOS RNA increase was not detected.
assertions.uncertainty: Magnitude unavailable; RNA non-detection can reflect sensitivity.
assertions.limitations: Three donors; endpoint depends on co-stimulation and viable-cell selection. No receptor-response or functional outcome inferred.

assertions.subject: CD14-positive monocyte
assertions.evidence_summary: Low monocyte CD4 protein signal was confirmed by flow cytometry.
assertions.uncertainty: Magnitude unavailable.
assertions.limitations: One donor; surface availability is not receptor function.

assertions.subject: rs202092481 (CD1C Arg43Ter)
assertions.evidence_summary: The CD1C stop-gain variant associated with lower circulating CD1C assay signal in the CSA subset.
assertions.effect_unit: SD of normalized signal per effect allele
assertions.uncertainty: P=1.4e-15; interval unavailable.
assertions.limitations: Variant-dependent binding/processing may affect signal. No cell source, surface CD1C or antigen-presentation outcome established.

assertions.subject: plasma IL6 assay signal
assertions.source_locator: Protein-phenotype associations paragraph; extract2.json source line 148, referring to Supplementary Table 18 (table not independently extracted)
assertions.evidence_summary: The IL6–IBD association did not replicate between the compared platform/cohort groups.
assertions.uncertainty: Per-assay direction, estimate and interval unavailable in extracted paragraph.
assertions.limitations: Platform and cohort differ together. A replication failure is not proof of no biological association.

assertions.subject: plasma CXCL9 assay signal
assertions.source_locator: Protein-phenotype associations paragraph; extract2.json source line 149, referring to Supplementary Table 18 (table not independently extracted)
assertions.evidence_summary: IBD associated with CXCL9 on Olink and one of two SomaScan assays.
assertions.assay: Olink Explore 3072; two SomaScan v4 reagents
assertions.uncertainty: Reagent identifiers and signed estimates unavailable.
assertions.limitations: The non-associating reagent may bind a different proteoform; identity is unresolved, not established.

assertions.subject: rs76863441
assertions.source_locator: Comparisons of pQTLs; Supplementary Fig.15 and Supplementary Data4
assertions.evidence_summary: Both platforms identified rs76863441 as a PLA2G7 cis-pQTL sentinel in CKB.
assertions.uncertainty: Signed effect, interval and target-specific P unavailable.
assertions.limitations: Same-sample agreement does not establish causality, enzyme activity or a source immune cell.

assertions.subject: thrombin
assertions.evidence_summary: Thrombin induced new platelet IL1B protein; puromycin prevented accumulation.
assertions.uncertainty: No numerical effect or interval extracted.
assertions.limitations: Small experiment series; donors unavailable. Source has 8 h versus 18 h microvesicle timing discrepancy.

assertions.subject: thrombin-stimulated platelet
assertions.evidence_summary: Mature IL1B appeared in soluble and microvesicle fractions outside stimulated platelets.
assertions.duration: 18 h in figure; methods state 8 h
assertions.uncertainty: No numerical effect or interval extracted.
assertions.limitations: Small experiment series; donors unavailable. Source has 8 h versus 18 h microvesicle timing discrepancy.

assertions.subject: platelet-derived microvesicle fraction containing IL1B
assertions.evidence_summary: Platelet microvesicles increased neutrophil adhesion after endothelial exposure.
assertions.uncertainty: No numerical effect or interval extracted.
assertions.causal_directness: fraction transfer with receptor antagonist control
assertions.limitations: Fraction contains additional mediators; not proof IL1B alone explains the complete response.
assertions.candidate_path: platelet -> extracellular IL1B-containing fraction -> endothelial response -> neutrophil adhesion

assertions.subject: IL1 receptor antagonist
assertions.evidence_summary: IL1 receptor blockade reduced the transferred-microvesicle adhesion response.
assertions.uncertainty: No numerical effect or interval extracted.
assertions.limitations: Small experiment series; donors unavailable. Source has 8 h versus 18 h microvesicle timing discrepancy.

assertions.subject: IL1 receptor antagonist
assertions.source_locator: Results accompanying Fig.4B; TNF control also labelled unpublished data
assertions.evidence_summary: The antagonist did not suppress TNF-induced adhesiveness in the reported specificity control.
assertions.uncertainty: Authors report control partly as unpublished data; no numeric uncertainty.
assertions.limitations: Small experiment series; donors unavailable. Source has 8 h versus 18 h microvesicle timing discrepancy.

gaps.description: Bounded pilot corpus, not exhaustive systematic search. Eight selected primary studies do not cover every measured cytokine, tissue, disease, ancestry, HLA/KIR context, secretome or PTM.

Atlas main raw proteome/secretome matrix and unique peptide evidence were not extracted. Atlas assertions are limited to the directly described IL34 profile perturbation. CITE-seq captions require figure/count-matrix review before stronger grading.
Mass-cytometry PTM sites, antibody clones, doses and durations were not retrieved from supplements. Family-level STAT5 and p38 names are deliberately not converted into specific isoforms or sites.

UKB/deCODE reused cohort links identified; participant manifests and exact sample overlap across publications unavailable. All independence statuses remain unresolved; no publication-count replication multiplier is justified.

Affinity assay identifiers, targeted proteoforms, LOD and per-target batch metadata remain incomplete. Plasma findings must not generate source-cell, secretion, receptor-availability or activity edges.
No receptor-dependent functional conclusion from REAP-seq IL7R abundance; no functional proliferation conclusion from MKI67 RNA. ICOS RNA null retains a sensitivity explanation.

Platelet timing conflicts: Fig.4A says 18 h while microvesicle methods state 8 h; immunocytochemistry figure/methods also differ in thrombin concentration (0.1 versus 0.01 U/ml). P_A18 uses the explicit Fig.2B/C synthesis comparison; timing remains visible.

Entrez skill script could not execute because requests dependency was missing in system and bundled Python. Public web and directly saved article pages were used instead. Europe PMC fullTextXML request for PMC3497699 returned 404; article was screened but not extracted.

synthesis: This bounded human-focused pilot separates total/surface protein abundance, phosphorylation, extracellular cytokine release, genetic associations with plasma assay signals, and measured adhesion. It preserves same-cell RNA/protein discordance and receptor-abundance/response mismatch. Platelet fraction-transfer experiments support an IL1-receptor-dependent functional component; other cross-layer paths remain candidates. UKB/deCODE reuse and paired assays cannot add independent biological weight. No probability is scientifically calibrated and no human adjudication is claimed.
